I + adv/prep: › [ I + adv/prep ] present participle lying, past tense lay, past participle lain to exist

NONE: › When the dead body of an important person lies in state, it is arranged so that the public can see and honour it before it is buried.
（重要人物的遺體埋葬前經整容後）供公衆瞻仰

I: B1 [ I ] present participle lying, past tense lied, past participle lied to say or write something that is not true in order to deceive someone

NONE: B1 something you say that you know is not true
謊話，瞎話

example: to lie in bed
躺在床上
to lie on a beach
躺在海灘上
to lie on your side
側臥
A cat lay in front of the fire.
一隻貓趴在爐火前。
He lies awake at night, worrying.
晚上他躺在床上焦慮不安，無法入睡。
A pen lay on the desk.
桌子上放著一枝鉛筆。
There's an old pair of shoes of yours lying at/in the bottom of the wardrobe.
衣櫃最下面放著一雙你的舊鞋子。
The river lies 30 km to the south.
那條河在南面30公里處。
The team is lying third in the league.
該隊在聯賽中位居第三。
Here lies the body of Mary Taylor (= this is where Mary Taylor is buried).
瑪麗‧泰勒葬於此處。
There are several houses lying empty in the town.
城裡有幾座空房子。
The town lay in ruins.
城鎮已成為一片廢墟。
The ship lies off (= is positioned near) the coast of Spain.
那艘船位於西班牙海岸附近。
The hardest part of the competition still lies ahead of us.
比賽最艱難的階段還在前面呢。
Responsibility for the disaster must ultimately lie with the government.
發生此次災難的責任最終必須由政府來承擔。
Where does the blame lie?
誰來承擔罪責？
Are you lying to me?
你是不是在跟我撒謊？
Don't trust her - she's lying.
別信她的——她在說謊。
I suspect he lies about his age.
我懷疑他虛報了年齡。
See also
liar
I told a lie when I said I liked her haircut.
我騙她說我喜歡她的髮型。

NONE: › If things are lying around, they are left in places where they should not be.
亂放，亂擱
› to spend time lying down and doing very little
無所事事，懶散度日

example: Has anyone seen my keys lying around?
有人看見我的鎖匙留在甚麽地方了嗎？
I wouldn't leave any money lying around the office if I were you.
我要是你就不會把錢在辦公室裡亂放。
I spent a week in Spain, lying around on the beach.
我在西班牙逗留了一周，在海灘上享受清閒。

NONE: › to move the top half of your body from a sitting to a lying position
向後躺，向後仰

example: She lay back in the dentist's chair and tried to relax.
她向後躺在牙醫的椅子上，儘量讓自己放鬆下來。

NONE: › If something lies behind something else, it is the hidden cause of it.
是隱藏在…背後的原因，是…的真實原因

example: Do you know what lies behind their decision?
你知道他們的決定背後的真實原因嗎？

NONE: › a piece of equipment used to try to discover if someone is telling lies
測謊儀

example: Both men refused to take a lie detector test.
兩個人都拒絕接受測謊儀的測試。

NONE: › to keep still and hide so that you cannot be found
隱蔽地埋伏著
A2 to move into a position in which your body is flat, usually in order to sleep or rest
躺下
› a short rest, usually in or on a bed
（通常指在床上）休息一會兒

example: He lay down on the bed and tried to relax.
他躺在床上想休息一下。
I usually have a lie-down after lunch.
我通常在午飯後躺下歇一會。
She said she was going for a lie-down.
她說會躺下休息一下。

NONE: › to fail to work as hard or as well as you should
偷懶，應付，湊合
› to stay in bed later than usual in the morning
睡懶覺
› a time when you stay in bed later than usual in the morning
（早晨）晚起床，賴床

example: It was a Sunday, so she could lie in till almost lunch time.
那是個星期天，所以她可以睡懶覺一直睡到快要吃午飯的時候。
I'm not working tomorrow so I can have a bit of a lie-in.
我明天不上班，所以我可以晚一點起床。

NONE: › to exist or be found in something
存在於；在於

example: His skill lies in his ability to communicate quite complex ideas very simply.
他的能力體現在能將複雜的思想用非常簡單的方式表達出來。
The play's interest lies in the questions it raises about sexuality.
這齣戲有趣的地方在於它提出了性的問題。

NONE: › to hide, ready to attack
埋伏起來

example: The gunmen were lying in wait when Mr Predit came out of the hotel.
當普雷迪特先生走出那家飯店時那些槍手正埋伏在周圍。

NONE: › to try not to be noticed
低調行事，不張揚

example: I'd lie low if I were you till the trouble passes.
我要是你就別張揚，等麻煩過去後再說。

NONE: › to tell someone something that you know is completely false
說謊話；睜眼說瞎話
› to hide from police officers, soldiers, etc. who are looking for you
躲避（警察或士兵等的搜索）

example: The escaped prisoners lay up in a barn for a few weeks, until the search had been called off.
逃犯在一個穀倉裡躲藏了數周，直到對他們的搜索取消為止。

NONE: › a small country in central Europe
列支敦斯登（中歐國家）
› belonging to or relating to Liechtenstein or its people
列支敦斯登的；列支敦斯登人的
› a person from Liechtenstein
列支敦斯登人
› a lord or king
王侯；君主

example: No man would break an oath to his liege.
沒人會違背對君主的承諾。
Yes, my liege.
是的，我的國王。

NONE: › an official order that allows someone to keep the property of a person who owes them money until it has been paid
（扣押某人財産直至其償清債務的）留置令，扣押令
› instead (of)
替代，取代（同 instead (of)）

example: He worked on Sunday and took Monday off in lieu.
他周日工作，這樣週一可以休息。
They gave some books in lieu of payment for the work I did.
對我做的這些工作，他們給了我一些書作為報酬而不是付錢。
The paintings were left to the nation by the Duke of Norfolk in lieu of inheritance taxes.
諾福克公爵把這些畫留給了國家，以代替交納遺産稅。

NONE: › written abbreviation for
lieutenant
› also Lieutenant (the title of) an officer of middle rank in the armed forces
中尉

example: first/second lieutenant
（美國）中尉／少尉
He was promoted to the rank of lieutenant.
他被升為中尉。
Lieutenant Woods/Charles Woods
伍茲/查理斯·伍茲中尉
[ as form of address ] Yes, Lieutenant.
是的，中尉。

NONE: › in the US, a state government official whose rank is just below the governor
（美國）副州長
› in Canada, Australia, India, and some other countries, an official who represents the head of state in a province, state, territory, etc.
（加拿大、澳大利亞、印度和其他一些國家）副總督
